components.name: freecom
components.selection: FreeDOS 1.4 com086 plus the M19 kswap fix series, imported by owner decision (cherry-picks recorded with -x; reference branch m20/kswap-fixes), plus the PC88VA platform changes
components.baseline_exemption: kernel-swap (KSSF) fixes from the M19 series change every non-PC88VA build: context ownership and counters across reload, child DOS return code, OOM fallback message and EXEC status separation, no swap for redirected/piped/batch commands; the bare com086 build differs, but the non-PC88VA build equals the m20/kswap-fixes reference

components.name: fc
components.role: utility disk: FreeDOS 1.4 FC 3.03 with Open Watcom LFN-failure detection fixes
components.selection: project fork; upstream base is the last upstream commit on or before the FreeDOS 1.4 release (2025-04-09)
components.baseline_exemption: Open Watcom portability fixes affecting every Open Watcom build: carry flag tested as zero/non-zero and AX=7100h treated as LFN failure. The upstream Open Watcom build loops forever on a DOS without LFN support (FreeDOS 1.4 FAT16 kernels, including the PC-88VA kernel); FreeDOS 1.4 shipped a Borland build, so no byte baseline exists. Checked by guest runs on PC (FAT32 and FAT16 FreeDOS 1.4 kernels) and VAEG.

components.name: attrib
components.role: utility disk: FreeDOS 1.4 ATTRIB 2.1 ported to Open Watcom
components.selection: project fork; upstream base is the last upstream commit on or before the FreeDOS 1.4 release (2025-04-09)
components.baseline_exemption: Borland/Turbo C program; FreeDOS 1.4 shipped a Borland build, so no Open Watcom byte baseline exists. The fork only adds __WATCOMC__ branches; removing them reproduces the upstream source (host test). Checked by guest runs on PC (FreeDOS 1.4 kernel) and VAEG.

components.name: tree
components.license: Public domain (pdTree 1.03; built without the optional LGPL Cats files)
components.role: utility disk: FreeDOS 1.4 TREE (pdTree) ported to Open Watcom with PC-88VA console defaults
components.selection: project fork; upstream base is the last upstream commit on or before the FreeDOS 1.4 release (2025-04-09)
components.baseline_exemption: C++ Borland/Turbo C program; FreeDOS 1.4 shipped a Borland build, so no Open Watcom byte baseline exists. The fork adds an Open Watcom DOS layer (w32fDOS/watcom), __WATCOMC__ branches and PC88VA branches; dropping those branches reproduces the upstream sources (host test). Checked by guest runs on PC (FAT32 and FAT16 FreeDOS 1.4 kernels) and VAEG.

components.name: unzip

components.selection: project import of the FreeDOS 1.4 package source (no FDOS Git repository); built unmodified from the import plus its provenance record
components.baseline_exemption: FreeDOS 1.4 shipped a different build of this program (32-bit DJGPP UNZIP, 32-bit UPX-packed ZIP, Borland GZIP), so no Open Watcom 16-bit byte baseline exists.
